descriptionEn: A house is offered for rent in Priam Village, Veternik.

The house is located in a gated, quiet and exclusive community, with access for residents only and 24/7 security. The location offers quick access to essential services, connecting roads and strategic points of reference.

The 135m² space includes a living room with kitchen, three bedrooms, two bathrooms, a technical room, two terraces and a private yard of 2.6 ares. The house is furnished and offers the option of furnishing two additional rooms as desired.
The building was built to modern standards, in a gated neighbourhood that guarantees security, privacy and a large functional yard.
